title: Local Tangent Space Alignment
text: mathematics descriptions LTSA always clear, happens: dataset X N items like reduce d dimensions. Create empty N x N matrix B (filled zeros). item dataset, define neighborhood, .e. k-nearest neighbors. Center k x p neighborhood matrix calculate SVD. Let U contain retained left singular vectors, give tangent coordinates k observations. Create local residual projector W=−𝟏𝟏𝖳/k−UU𝖳W = - \mathbf{1}\mathbf{1}^{\mathsf T}/k - UU^{\mathsf T}. Update elements N x N matrix B values W adding elements W entries B correspond items neighborhood. Repeat items dataset. B now symmetric positive-semidefinite LTSA alignment operator constant vector known null direction. Remove direction select lowest d nonconstant directions embedding. nullspace need one-dimensional, necessarily unique smallest eigenvector.

title: Local Tangent Space Alignment
text: ’s one function flotsam: ltsa. parameters may worth modifying roughly descending order importance: ndim: number dimensions reduce . Usually 2 visualization. n_neighbors: number neighbors use local neighborhood. computed neighbors requested omitted, default smaller 15 maximum permitted N include_self (N self N - 1 without self). must still least ndim + 2; data small meet minimum produce error. value low can leave disconnected effective-neighborhood components poorly separated low-energy directions. "nnd": Use approximate nearest neighbors Nearest Neighbor Descent. default appropriate large datasets. "exact": Use exact nearest neighbors exhaustively comparing items. Slow large datasets. precomputed nearest-neighbor index matrix, nearest-neighbor result object idx matrix. include_self = TRUE, shape N x n_neighbors every row contains index. include_self = FALSE, shape N x (n_neighbors + 1), self must first column, column removed assembly. include_self: Whether include item neighbor. Zhang co-workers suggest effect main difference LTSA Hessian Locally Linear Embedding (HLLE) method, setting FALSE may allow emulating HLLE. Default TRUE. n_threads: number threads use nearest neighbor calculation. Default 1. rnndescent backend treats 0 1 serial execution; values greater 1 request multithreaded execution. Multithreaded approximate searches need reproduce identical neighbor graph across runs. n_assembly_threads: number threads use constructing LTSA matrix B. Default 1, requests serial assembly generally uses less temporary storage. Values greater 1 request parallel construction B, trades additional storage speed may compound threaded-BLAS oversubscription. See threading warning. "auto": Use dense base::eigen() N <= dense_n eig_k >= dense_fraction * N, otherwise use RSpectra::eigs_sym(). default. "rspectra": Always use RSpectra::eigs_sym(). "irlba": Always use irlba::irlba() post-hoc residual diagnostics. "svdr": Always use irlba::svdr() post-hoc residual diagnostics. "eigen" "eig": Use base::eigen(). converts B dense matrix computes full eigensystem, retains lowest eig_k candidate vectors Rayleigh–Ritz postprocessing. terms memory usage CPU time feasible small datasets, useful diagnostic reference. eig_k: number eigenvectors return post-processing step final ndim return. NULL, default min(N - 1L, max(12, ndim + 2)). Must satisfy ndim + 1 <= eig_k < n. Asking eigenvectors necessary seems improve reliability final result: RSpectra may otherwise miss eigenvectors close zero, fail converge tolerance tightened. default seems sufficiently generous cases. Dense eigenanalysis still uses eig_k limit candidate span passed postprocessing step. “Numerical Diagnostics” article details. normalize: Whether solve generalized problem Bv=λDvBv = \lambda Dv, D=diag⁡(B)D = \operatorname{diag}(B). different problem standard LTSA, D-weighted orthogonality centering constraints, rather merely numerically conditioned route coordinates. "embedding": Return embedding matrix. default. "result": Return list containing embedding, compact eigenanalysis diagnostics, assembly diagnostics, optionally assembled unnormalized LTSA matrix B. "B": Skip final eigenanalysis return raw alignment matrix normalize = FALSE, normalized operator D−1/2BD−1/2D^{-1/2} B D^{-1/2} normalize = TRUE. include_B: Whether include assembled unnormalized LTSA matrix B result. eig_method = "auto", dense base::eigen() selected N <= 100 eig_k >= 0.5 * N; dense_n dense_fraction change thresholds. Otherwise automatic selection uses RSpectra. title: Fast LOcal Tangent Space Alignment Method
text: Fast LOcal Tangent Space Alignment Method implementation Local Tangent Space Alignment method (Zhang & Zha, 2004), spectral method dimensionality reduction. one methods can unroll “swiss roll” data set variants without major distortion. consider implementation “Fast” use approximate nearest neighbors. Internally works sparse matrices require calculating eigenvectors, can scale large datasets.

text: ltsa() accepts numeric matrix data frame; non-numeric data-frame columns ignored. neighborhoods use distances, scale variables first units comparable. n_neighbors controls local approximation must least ndim + 2; omitted computed neighbors, flotsam uses 15 neighbors, limited dataset size. Approximate neighbor search can vary runs, multithreaded searches need reproduce identical neighbor graph.

title: Fast LOcal Tangent Space Alignment Method
code: library(flotsam)  # Create a "swiss roll": 2D rectangle rolled up in 3D n <- 1000 max_z <- 10  # phi represents the position along the roll phi <- stats::runif(n, min = 1.5 * pi, max = 4.5 * pi) x <- phi * cos(phi) y <- phi * sin(phi) z <- stats::runif(n, max = max_z) swiss_roll <- data.frame(x, y, z)  # See side section to prove it's rolled plot(swiss_roll$x, swiss_roll$y, col = phi)  # unroll it swiss_unrolled <- ltsa(swiss_roll, verbose = TRUE) plot(swiss_unrolled, col = phi)

title: Local Tangent Space Alignment — ltsa
text: X input data matrix data frame one observation per row. data frame supplied, non-numeric columns ignored. least one numeric column required. n_neighbors size local neighborhood (terms number neighboring sample points) used manifold approximation. NULL, computed-neighbor default smaller 15 maximum permitted number observations include_self; precomputed graph supplied nn_method, inferred graph. must least ndim + 2 local projector residual direction beyond constant tangent subspaces. Data small meet minimum produce error. ndim dimension space embed . nn_method Method finding nearest neighbors, precomputed nearest-neighbor graph. Can one : "nnd" Approximate nearest neighbors Nearest Neighbor Descent. "exact" Exact nearest neighbors exhaustively comparing items. Slow large datasets. precomputed nearest-neighbor index matrix. nearest-neighbor result object idx matrix. eig_method carry final eigendecomposition. Possible values : "auto" Use dense base::eigen() n <= dense_n eig_k >= dense_fraction * n, otherwise use RSpectra::eigs_sym(). default. "rspectra" Always use RSpectra::eigs_sym(). method can report hard backend convergence failures RSpectra's nconv metadata. "irlba" Always use irlba::irlba() post-hoc residual diagnostics. "svdr" Always use irlba::svdr() post-hoc residual diagnostics. "eig" "eigen" Use base::eigen() function. feasible small datasets used diagnostic purposes . Dense "eig" better diagnostic reference algebraic eigenvalue ordering matters. eig_k Number candidate vectors requested final eigensolver. NULL, default min(n - 1L, max(12L, ndim + 2L)), n number observations. Must satisfy ndim + 1 <= eig_k < n. Larger values give Rayleigh-Ritz postprocessing wider candidate span. Dense eigenanalysis computes full eigensystem, retains lowest eig_k candidate vectors postprocessing. output return: "embedding" Return embedding matrix. default. "result" Return list containing embedding, compact eigenanalysis diagnostics, assembly diagnostics, optionally B. "B" Skip final eigenanalysis return raw alignment matrix normalize = FALSE, normalized operator described normalize = TRUE. include_B TRUE output = "result", include assembled unnormalized LTSA matrix B result object. Ignored output modes. include_self item part neighborhood? minor effect results, work Zhang co-workers (2017) suggests effect main difference LTSA Hessian Locally Linear Embedding (HLLE) method, setting FALSE may allow emulating HLLE method. normalize TRUE, use normalized LTSA formulation described "Normalized LTSA" section, including output = "B". default FALSE, uses standard LTSA formulation. n_threads Nonnegative number threads nearest-neighbor calculation. rnndescent backend treats 0 1 serial execution; values greater 1 request multithreaded execution. control LTSA matrix assembly. n_assembly_threads Number threads use constructing LTSA alignment matrix B nearest neighbors computed. default 1 requests serial assembly. Values greater 1 request parallel assembly, trades additional temporary storage speed. See threading note avoiding oversubscription BLAS also multithreaded. verbose TRUE log information progress console. ... Optional eigensolver diagnostic controls. See Eigensolver controls section.

Inspect output = "result" component diagnostics and increase n_neighbors or revise neighbor construction so effective neighborhoods overlap.  # Request compact eigenanalysis and assembly diagnostics. iris_result <- ltsa(   small_iris,   n_neighbors = 12,   nn_method = "exact",   eig_k = 8,   output = "result" ) iris_result$eigen$status #> [1] "ok" iris_result$eigen$messages #> character(0) iris_result$eigen$method #> [1] "auto" iris_result$eigen$backend$name #> [1] "dense_eigen"  # Return the raw LTSA alignment matrix. iris_B <- ltsa(   small_iris,   n_neighbors = 12,   nn_method = "exact",   output = "B" ) dim(iris_B) #> [1] 75 75

title: flotsam 0.0.0.9002
text: output = "B" now honors normalize: returns raw LTSA alignment matrix default normalized operator supplied eigenanalysis normalize = TRUE, still skipping eigenanalysis. computed neighbors requested n_neighbors omitted, default now smaller 15 largest neighborhood permitted dataset include_self. Explicit values precomputed-neighbor inference retain existing validation behavior. Assembly resources now controlled n_assembly_threads: 1 requests serial assembly larger values request parallel assembly. copy_max_mib argument removed; row-major copying now internal optimization. eig_method now defaults "auto", retains existing dense threshold policy otherwise uses RSpectra. Explicit "rspectra", "irlba", "svdr" requests now always use named backend, including small inputs. Dense thresholds accepted "auto", backend controls explicit backend, shift_eps explicit iterative method. Existing calls tune backend must now name explicitly. detailed results, eigen$method records "auto" explicit canonical method, eigen$backend$name records backend actually ran. New argument: eig_k, controls number eigenvectors return Rayleigh-Ritz processing step final ndim return. Increasing total number eigenvectors return seems work better parameters cases clusters eigenvalues: RSpectra may entirely miss one results even reports full convergence. New argument: output. output = "result" returns compact eigenanalysis assembly diagnostics. output = "B" replaces older ret_B = TRUE argument. Removed automatic adaptive rescue/refinement introduced 0.0.0.9001. Eigenanalysis now makes one fixed-width candidate request controlled eig_k, followed Rayleigh-Ritz processing diagnostics; request larger eig_k explicitly wider candidate span needed.

title: flotsam 0.0.0.9001
text: New parameter: n_assembly_threads control number threads construct B matrix. can now pass precomputed nearest-neighbor index (full dense neighbor graph list created rnndescent) directly nn_method, example ltsa(X, nn_method = nn$idx). Leave n_neighbors unset using correct number neighbors inferred graph. LTSA matrix construction improved high-dimensional inputs (ncol(X) larger n_neighbors) using row-major centered Gram triangular matrix taking advantage B matrix symmetry. New parameter: copy_max_mib control size cap optional row-major dense copy. default 256 MiB. Replaced old sparse slot-search LTSA assembly path serial append/finalize C++ builder. Now modestly faster slightly less peak memory usage. robust eigenanalysis convergence. Iterative eigenanalysis now extracts eigenvectors requested uses null-aware Rayleigh-Ritz polishing candidate subspace attempt better final result. verbose = TRUE reports residual, rank, boundary-gap diagnostics. eig_method = "irlba" "svdr" paths now share postprocessing, rely post-hoc diagnostics report RSpectra-style convergence counts. LTSA now warns final eigenanalysis diagnostics indicate ambiguous low-energy eigenspace, extra near-zero nonconstant modes weak boundary gap requested embedding dimensions. can indicate disconnected weakly connected neighborhood graph, -small n_neighbors, ndim cutting low-energy eigenspace. ndim eigenvalues appear contain part near-zero low-energy cluster, refinement step added tighter settings candidates case eigenvectors missed.
